decision: 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 7 for the 12 month period).
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed track and in-car video evidence. PER was trying to overtake MAG on the inside of turn 11. The Stewards determine that PER was predominately to blame for the collision. Applying the 2023 Driving Standards Guidelines for overtaking at the inside of a corner, the Stewards noted that there was no significant portion of car 11 alongside car 20 and therefore determined that car 11 was not entitled to racing room in turn 11. PER did not manage to do the overtaking manoeuvre in a safe and controlled manner.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
